subtests.name: grid-lanes followed by !important
e.style['grid-lanes'] = "\"a\" calc(10px) column-reverse" should set the property value
e.style['grid-lanes'] = "minmax(calc(30% + 40vw), 10px)" should set the property value
grid-lanes: minmax(10px, 20px) row should be valid.

grid-lanes: "a" 10px should be valid.
grid-lanes: "a b" 10px 20px row should be valid.
grid-lanes: "a b c" 10% 20% 30% row-reverse should be valid.
grid-lanes: repeat(5, auto) row should be valid.
